name: Short Call Ladder (Bear Call Ladder)
summary: Sell 1 lower call, buy 1 middle call, buy 1 higher call, all same expiry; a credit structure with defined downside, a loss valley in the middle, and unlimited upside profit.

legs.strike_rule: K1 = ITM or ATM, call delta 0.55-0.70
K2 = K1 + W, call delta 0.35-0.45; W = 1.5-2.5% of spot
K3 = K2 + W (equal spacing), call delta 0.20-0.30

when_to_use: IV rank < 30, flat-to-inverted call skew, and an expected explosive move higher. It is a call ratio backspread with the second long moved further out, which softens the loss valley at the cost of a smaller upside slope.
max_loss: (K2 - K1) x 100 - net credit, reached at K2. Defined.
breakevens: lower: none when opened for a credit; upper breakeven = K3 + (K2 - K1) - credit/100 (solve exactly from the payoff)

greeks.delta: near flat at entry, strongly positive above K3
greeks.theta: negative when spot sits between K1 and K3

entry_rules: Open for a net CREDIT; reject debit fills.
Equal strike spacing K1->K2 and K2->K3.
Max loss ((K2 - K1) x 100 - credit) <= 1.5% of equity per unit.
IV rank < 30 and a catalyst or breakout setup inside the expiry.
All three strikes: OI >= 500, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid).
Single 3-leg limit order at mid; must remain a credit.
management_rules: Close at 100% of max-loss amount in profit on the upside.
Close at 14 DTE regardless of P/L - the valley between K1 and K3 deepens sharply into expiry.
Stop at 60% of theoretical max loss.
Do not roll; close and re-establish if the thesis survives.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: 1 short call at K1, the deepest ITM strike in the structure. Flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the K1 short call is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10 - which is the normal state of an ITM short call in this structure.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before every ex-dividend date whenever K1 is ITM; an ITM short call with low extrinsic is assigned on the day before ex-div with high probability.
assignment_risk: One short call at K1, which is chosen ITM or ATM at entry - meaning early assignment risk is present from day one, not just at expiry. Assignment delivers -100 shares, economically hedged by the two long calls but operationally a short stock position the system must not carry. Dividend-driven assignment is the main path.
buying_power: (K2 - K1) x 100 - net credit, per unit.
common_mistakes: Opening for a debit (adds a downside loss zone to an already-awkward payoff); using unequal spacing; forgetting the ITM short call's dividend assignment risk; holding into the valley at expiry.
zero_dte_notes: Not recommended - an ITM short call at 0DTE is the most assignment-prone leg type in the bank, and the upside slope needs time to pay.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
bias_note: bullish breakout with a neutral-to-bearish consolation prize; long-vol
